This figure is the as-built wall under the governing pressure case at the design condition, and it is important to understand that the allowance is intended to be gradually consumed over the inspection interval rather than retained as spare strength, which means the stated thickness should not be regarded as a margin that can simply be traded away during fabrication. On this basis, the higher-rated material emerges as the preferred option.
